remark: BLM page states no season (only 'Individual sites are available on a first-come, first-serve basis. Three group sites are reservable through Recreation.gov.'). rec.gov facility 251842 is 'Big Bend Group Sites' only and its text gives no season either, so the chip's 02-10/11-30 comes from the 3 group sites' calendar, not the FCFS individual sites.

quote:
Seasons of Use
May through October
remark: Overview agrees: 'the operating season is from May 1 to the end of October, weather permitting.' Water only 'from May 1st to September 30th.' Booking disagrees with the entry (reservable false, fcfs always): '18 single sites and two double sites are available as well with some reservable and some only available on a first come, first served basis.' The website's old recarea?recid=13300 URL redirects to the forest's recreation index; the campground page is the url here.

quote:
Seasons of Use
Mid June - Late September
remark: Current Conditions: 'Typically open mid June-late September'; 'Sites may be booked at Recreation.Gov through late September.' 'Late' read as the last day, so the chip's 09-17 is 13 days short; marginal, since 'late September' is loose. No first-come sites named (rec.gov mentions 'Multiple self-pay fee stations'), so not flagged as a booking window.

quote:
Seasons of Use
Mid-June - End of October
remark: Close matches the chip; the agency adds the mid-June opening the chip lacks. Page also: 'Sites may be booked on Recreation.Gov through the end of October.' and 'Reservations must be made 4 days in advance'. Page says 16 sites (the note says 8).

Current Conditions line; chip closes 10-05, 20 days short. 'For reservable sites, reservations must be made at least 5 days in advance' and the FF-sites notice on rec.gov fit the entry's fcfs some_sites.

Current Conditions line; chip opens 05-22 (11 days late, the Friday of Memorial Day weekend 2026) and has no close. rec.gov: 'A Loop is FF through entire season', so the calendar edge is the reservable loops' start.

Current Conditions line; chip closes 09-08 (day after Labor Day 2026), 12 days short. Booking: the entry has no fcfs value, but the rec.gov notice block carries the concessionaire's 'First Come First Served (FF) sites' text (claim in person on the day), without naming which sites. Page also: '2 day minimum stay on weekends', '3 day minimum stay on holiday weekends'.

Current Conditions line; chip closes 09-08 (day after Labor Day 2026), 12 days short. Booking: the entry has no fcfs value, but the rec.gov notice is headed 'Advance reservations/First Come First Served (FF) sites' (concessionaire boilerplate; no sites named). Page also: '2 day minimum stay on weekends and a 3 day minimum stay on holiday weekends'.

quote: Winter Closure | October 21 | April 3 | The dates listed below are weather-dependent and therefore subject to change.
remark: The campground page (https://www.nps.gov/dino/planyourvisit/greenrivercampground.htm) renders its Operating Hours & Seasons from this JSON; quote joins the 'Winter Closure' exception's name, date_start, date_end and description. Open = the day after the closure ends to the day before it starts. Reservations: 'Sites in Loop C are first-come, first-served when Green River Campground is open. Reservations are available for the A and B Loop sites during peak season dates, approximately mid-May through September.' (the entry's note says Loop B reservable, Loops A and C first-come; the agency says A and B reservable, C first-come).

Current Conditions line; chip closes 10-05, 13 days short. Also 'No water available.' in Current Conditions. Booking: the entry has no fcfs value, but the rec.gov notice block carries the concessionaire's 'First Come First Served (FF) sites' text (claim in person on the day), without naming which sites.
